correctness.rationale: The endpoint identity follows by inverting the Jacobi tail and is summably close to a_j/lambda. Pointwise head resolvents plus a summable uniform tail and N(lambda-lambda_N)->0 prove relative endpoint Perron convergence; a Schur complement and non-Perron spectral gap give delta_N asymptotic to a_N^2 psi_N^2/lambda. A standalone high-precision checker corroborates the exact factor.
